text: 天孚通信午间公告，公司将于2026年11月9日召开股东会，对回购股份方案进行审议。公司关注到中国人民银行于2026年11月4日发布了加力实施股票回购增持再贷款政策，对股票回购增持再贷款利率进行下调。公司将结合回购再贷款政策、自身经营状况、市场走势等，适时研究并依法合规充分运用政策工具，维护公司价值与全体股东利益。
text_en: Tianfu Communication announced at midday that the company will hold a shareholders' meeting on November 9, 2026 to review the share repurchase plan. The company noted that the People's Bank of China issued on November 4, 2026 a policy to intensify the implementation of the relending facility for share repurchases and increased holdings, lowering the rate on the relending facility for share repurchases and increased holdings. The company will, in light of the repurchase relending policy, its own operating conditions and market trends, study in due course and fully use policy tools in accordance with laws and regulations to safeguard company value and the interests of all shareholders.
